Population increased in Rushmoor

The estimated population of Rushmoor in 2024 was 105,751 usual residents, a rise of 2.3% since 2023.

This meant that Rushmoor's rate of population change placed it among the 10 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Rushmoor increased by 5.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Rushmoor was also among the 20% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Rushmoor

The average (median) age fell to 38 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Rushmoor has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Rushmoor is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Rushmoor's population of 105,751 usual residents was made up of:

  • 20,013 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.9%)
  • 69,614 people aged 16 to 64 years, (65.8%)
  • 16,124 people aged 65 years and over, (15.2%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Rushmoor has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (15.2% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Rushmoor, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Rushmoor
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Rushmoor, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 503 people (0.5%). In total, there were 1,229 births and 726 deaths in Rushmoor.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 180 (0.2%). There were 7,396 people entering the area and 7,216 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Rushmoor's population of 1,768 (1.7%) as a result of 2,256 people entering the area and 488 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Rushmoor was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Rushmoor in mid-2023 is 103,379.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 732 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 261 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 471 people.
